overview.overview:
Indiana is projected to remain firmly Republican in 2028. The state backed the Republican presidential nominee by about 16 points in 2020 and by about 19 points in 2024, and it leans roughly 18 points more Republican than the nation as a whole. The forecast projects a Republican margin of about 12.5 points, with a plausible range from about 3 to 22 points.

No public polls of the state are available yet, so the outlook rests on past results and the broader national picture. Indiana is not expected to be decisive in the Electoral College. Its eleven electoral votes are very unlikely to determine the winner under current conditions.
overview.watch: A large, sustained national shift toward Democrats, or a strong home-state candidate, would be needed to narrow the margin substantially.
key_factors: Republican presidential margins of roughly 16 and 19 points in 2020 and 2024
A lean about 18 points more Republican than the nation
A national environment adjustment of 5.5 points that does not close the gap
No state polling or candidate-specific information is available yet
